contracts.tracking: Fixed exp(-4*planar_error_squared), exp(-4*yaw_error_squared); coefficients 2.0 and 0.5; no dynamic sigma.
contracts.joint_limit: Count joints strictly outside Isaac Lab soft limits (URDF midpoint +/- soft_dof_pos_limit * half-range), coefficient -2.0; equality is allowed.
contracts.time_scaling: Reward coefficients multiplied by control dt exactly once.
contracts.reproduction_assumptions: Load motion uses 1/(1+L2 norm of physical body-relative load velocity). Shared air-time/contact-force and compatible addition conventions retained; not exact author-code reproduction.
contracts.resume: Fresh physical reset with restored learning/RNG/curricula. No exact PhysX continuation. Incompatible reward/input/physical contracts are rejected, not silently migrated.
contracts.budget: --max-iterations is TOTAL absolute updates; --additional-iterations is explicitly additional and resume-only. Final checkpoint is always written.
contracts.geometry: Seeded per-environment size bank, creation-time only. No runtime geometry scaling. Mass/inertia/friction/spawn changes occur only on eligible resets.
contracts.stage1: Disturbance progress zero: physically simulated 0.2-0.4 kg box; displacement <=0.01 m per axis, relative velocity 0, friction 0.8-1.0; inherited velocity pushes scaled by 0.01, latched per environment on reset. Persistent external wrenches are disabled in all BR stages.
contracts.stage2: Existing disturbance progress interpolates toward mass 1-3 kg, displacement <=0.10 m per axis, relative velocity <=0.40 m/s per horizontal axis, friction 0.10-0.60. Usable tray footprint further limits displacement. Shared warmup/performance gates/cadence are retained, not reset.
contracts.stage_transition: Stage 2 starts automatically when the shared disturbance progress becomes positive. No separate start iteration or manual stage selection. Live HardPACT warmup, earlier curriculum phases, performance gates, increments and reset-resampling conventions govern the ramp. Current push_warmup=10000; this is not a guaranteed Stage 2 start iteration.
contracts.phase: Both physical stages default to teacher_student. Only --student-start-iteration optionally schedules an independent optimization-phase change.
contracts.migration: Version-4/manual-stage physical checkpoints are rejected explicitly; no automatic migration. New checkpoints restore the shared disturbance progress and gates before a fresh physical reset.
contracts.archives: run_manifest.json, resolved/inheritance/reward JSON, sources.tar.gz (BR plus shared Python/shell dependencies), result.json and model_N.pt. Original resume directory cannot be reused. Active stage/phase and approved overrides are recorded separately.
